Obtain SI Figs.S14-S19 for solvatochromism, delay-resolved crystal spectra, fitted RTP lifetimes, lab-carbazole controls and oxygen-dependent solution decays. These were reported in main text, not personally inspected.

Packing and RIM interpretations are retained as bounded source explanations, not definitive causality. Close pi contacts do not establish excimer/H/J emission.
Do not transfer DiCz-Sac TADF or its 3.2 microsecond lifetime to this mono-carbazole target; the source reports no delayed fluorescence component.
The main text and Table 1 appear inconsistent in assigning the origin of some S1 energies (computed versus spectral); only the explicitly described 0.31/0.28/0.20 eV spectroscopic gap series is used.
